title.narrative: ISAR Ednannia - Strong Civil Society of Ukraine - a driver towards reforms and democracy

description.narrative:
The project "Strong Civil Society of Ukraine - a driver towards reforms and democracy", by the Initiative Center to Support Social Action "Ednannia" aims at strengthening CSOs to foster inclusive and sustainable recovery and to advance democratic governance reforms in Ukraine through small grants programs, educational and networking activities and research. This will be accomplished through three specific objectives:
Objective 1: Strengthen organisational capacities of Ukrainian CSOs Outcome: Strengthened organisational capacities of CSOs. Activities include providing capacity-building through small grants and educational activities such as workshops, webinars, and the development of an educational program. The focus is on enhancing functional and adaptive capacities of CSOs. Research and Media grants will support activities in the Objective 1 scope, providing opportunities of research-based action planning to CSOs and informational campaigns to the project, CSOs and the general population of Ukraine.
Objective 2: Enhance capacities of CSOs to contribute to inclusive and sustainable recovery Outcome: Strengthened capacities of CSOs to contribute to recovery across all governance levels. Activities include offering Recovery grants to improve technical capacities of CSOs, particularly in gender-responsive planning, social services provision, transparency tools, and environmental action. Mentoring programs are also utilised to support organisational development.
Objective 3: Empower CSOs to engage in advocacy and policy formulation Outcome: Strengthened capacities of CSOs to engage in advocacy and policy formulation for democratic governance reforms. Activities involve providing Advocacy grants to enhance influencing capacities of CSOs through research, advocacy campaigns, policy formulation, and monitoring reforms. Similar to Objective 2, mentoring programs are offered to build influential skills and competences.
